experiment_a.basis: acyclic NAND DAG; arbitrary fanout; repeated gate inputs; variable or gate output; no free constants
experiment_a.failure: Class mismatch, invalid group action, or no reduction in the declared construction-volume counters.
experiment_a.pass: Exact function class is preserved after orbit expansion and construction-volume counters fall.
experiment_a.question: Can certified input-variable symmetry reduce bounded NAND circuit-population construction before full population enumeration?
experiment_a.selector_certificate: Use only input-variable permutations that preserve the succinct bounded NAND language and the all-ones paired query; never derive the group from an enumerated survivor population.

experiment_b.candidate_pool: all nonconstant original coordinates; prefilter top four by frozen original occurrence score, ties by lower index
experiment_b.claim_ceiling: Finite bounded discriminator only. A depth reduction is not a total-cost win. Timeout/resource exhaustion is not UNSAT. No P-vs-NP conclusion.
experiment_b.planning_probe: simulate both Boolean child conditions with exact GF(5) feedback solver and independent feedback checker; do not reuse simulated child results during actual recursion
